entries.what: Brenda's Monday check-in email lands at 8:15 while Elliot is mid-bottle; he reads it, flags it for later and logs Theo's naps. Judith arrives at 8 and reorganizes the diaper shelf.
entries.outcome: Email left unanswered until nap time; shelf quietly left as is.

entries.what: Stroller laps around Delgado Park with Theo after the marsh trail stayed closed, squeaky front wheel announcing them.
entries.outcome: Theo fell asleep in the stroller for 40 minutes.

entries.what: Evening witching hour at home; Elliot hums the slowed-down ballpark organ tune while Hana gets home and takes over dinner cleanup.
Three crib naps at 9, 12:30 and 4; Elliot uses the first one to work through a training module on reassessment software.
Lunch of scrambled eggs with Judith, who labels leftovers in her librarian handwriting.
Tuesday night baby laundry at the card-only Marisol Gardens laundry room after Theo's bedtime.
Theo's four-month well visit with Dr. Fong at 9:40 at the Plaza Marisol clinic; Elliot brings his logged feed and nap numbers.
entries.outcome: Checkup went fine and Dr. Fong approved the routine.

entries.what: Afternoon at home logging in the tracker app; Judith and Hana both add entries.
Takeout rare beef pho, no tripe, from Phở Bến Thành eaten while Theo sleeps.
Thursday baby story time at the library at 10:30 with Kaitlyn's group; Theo stares at the egret puppet.
entries.outcome: Chatted with two other parents about daycare.

entries.what: Stroller walk at Delgado Park then groceries planned for the weekend; Elliot writes a list of two dishes for Sunday batch cooking.
Evening crying stretch; Walter's note taped to the door is ignored this time.
Friday morning: Judith drives home to her Tamsen city condo at 5, so Elliot spends the afternoon alone with Theo; a nap goes sideways.
entries.outcome: Nap salvaged with a contact hold.

entries.what: Friday night baby laundry and a quick check of the delivery diaper order.
Watches Hana feed Theo and does the 2 a.m. feed later that night.
Saturday market run at Ruiz Family Market with Theo in the carrier, buying ingredients for Sunday's batch cook.
Passing the parish food drive on the way home, he picks up a bag of groceries offered to families and chats briefly with volunteers.
Afternoon puzzle session on the lighthouse jigsaw while Theo naps.
Sunday batch cooking: chili and a pan of baked pasta while Theo naps, with oat milk for his own coffee.
entries.outcome: Two dishes portioned for the week.

entries.what: Stroller walk around Delgado Park with Hana after lunch.
Planning Thanksgiving potluck for Nov 27 at 209 with Hana, assigning dishes to Judith and Hana's parents.
